subject: Security package & scale: pricing clarifications and packaging
body:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@helixhealth.com>
To: mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@helixhealth.com
Date: 2027-11-21T09:12:00Z
Subject: Security add-ons pricing & evidence for procurement

Hi Mateo + Ben,

Thanks for the demo last week — HelixHealth is aligned on using Redwood for core inference, but procurement has a few outstanding questions specifically around the compliance/security add-ons (audit logs, KMS/HSM, data residency and HIPAA scope). Attached is our checklist; we need line-item pricing and an example annual cost for a ~50M token/month workload across 3 US regions.

Key asks:
- Are audit logs billed by retention tier (e.g., 90/365/730 days) or by ingestion volume?
- Does KMS/HSM pricing include per-region seats or a single global seat with egress allowances?
- Can we get a one-year blended discount if we commit to Dedicated capacity?
- Evidence delivery timeline for SOC/Security artifacts (we need sample audit reports + implementation plan).

Can you share a short pricing sketch and recommended packaging by EOD?

Best,
Olivia Chen
Head of IT Procurement
HelixHealth

---

From: mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@helixhealth.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2027-11-21T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Security add-ons pricing & evidence for procurement

Olivia — thanks for the clear checklist, that helps a lot. Attaching a quick sketch (see attachments) and a short note on our recommended packaging:

Summary (high-level):
- Audit logs: charged by ingestion (per-GB) with optional retention tiers. Base model: per-GB ingestion + incremental retention fee (90/365/730). For 50M tokens/month we estimate ~1.8–2.2 TB/mo of logs depending on verbosity; I included a conservative 2.1 TB estimate.
- KMS/HSM: region-bound seats (HSM appliance or managed HSM instances). Pricing model: per-seat annual + optional key-usage metering for high-volume crypto ops.
- Data residency: add-on per-region surcharge (one-time activation + monthly residency fee).
- HIPAA: compliance bundle that includes SOC artifacts, BAAs, and 1x annual evidence delivery. Additional evidence can be scheduled for a fee.

Suggested packaging (to start):
1) Pilot Bundle (Q1): Hosted Redwood API + Audit logs (90-day retention) + regional KMS with 2 HSM seats shared across 3 regions. Small onboarding fee waived.
2) Production Bundle (annual commit): Dedicated capacity (committed vGPU) + Audit logs (365-day retention) + per-region HSM seats (recommended 1 seat/region) + HIPAA bundle. Offer: 15% off for annual commit on Dedicated + 10% off compliance add-ons first year.

I'll loop in Monica for the amortization/credit structure and Ben on commercial guardrails. Attaching the one-pager and the rough cost model.

- Mateo
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: pricing-sketch.xlsx (spread), evidence-delivery-sla.pdf (summary)

---

From: monica.patel@redwoodinference.com <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@helixhealth.com>
Date: 2027-11-21T11:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Security add-ons pricing & evidence for procurement

Thanks Mateo — added a commercial suggestion below that balances Helix's ask for predictability and Redwood's need to protect margin.

Commercial suggestion:
- One-time onboarding & evidence delivery fee: $25k (covers SOC packaging, initial evidence handoff, dedicated SRE time).
- Audit logs: $0.09/GB ingestion + retention slabs: 90d (no extra), 365d (+$0.03/GB/mo), 730d (+$0.06/GB/mo). Example: 2.1TB/mo ingestion -> $189/mo ingestion + $63/mo for 365d retention = $252/mo.
- HSM/KMS: per-region seat $18k/seat/yr or $1.6k/mo seat. Recommend 3 seats for high-availability across 3 regions. Seat pricing includes KMS integration and 24/7 support.
- Residency surcharge: $4k/region/mo for dedicated residency stack (includes data plane and egress controls).

Discount proposal:
- If Helix signs a 12-month Dedicated commit (min monthly vGPU throughput TBA), offer a 20% discount on compliance add-ons in year 1 and a $50k onboarding credit amortized over the first 6 months.

Notes/risks:
- HSM seat pricing is capital-light for us but stick to per-seat to avoid unbounded crypto-op costs. If Helix demands pure metered crypto ops instead of seats, we need to model high-volume churn.
- Audit retention longer than 365d starts to change storage economics; propose a separate SLA + storage-pass-through if they need >730d.

Monica Patel
Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

---

From: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@helixhealth.com>
Date: 2027-11-21T13:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Security add-ons pricing & evidence for procurement

Appreciate the draft. A couple of points from a deal-protection perspective:
- Avoid unconditional broad discounts on HSM seats — propose a graduated discount tied to committed vGPU throughput (e.g., 10% at baseline commit, 18% at +50% commit).
- For audit logs, offering a volume tier at 5 TB+ should cap unit cost and protect against unexpectedly high verbosity.
- The $50k onboarding credit looks fine, but structure it as a rebate applied to first 3 invoices (not immediate cash credit). That simplifies escrow/accounting.

Ben's quick proposed headline commercial (to present to procurement):
- Annual Dedicated commit (terms TBD) + 15% off platform list for year 1
- Compliance add-ons: 12-month term, 15% discount year 1, HSM seats priced as Monica suggested with tiered discount for higher commit levels
- Onboarding: $25k invoiced, $50k rebate applied over first 3 invoices if commit sign-off within 30 days.

Ben Carter
VP, Sales
Redwood Inference
